answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond before it can earn weight, and let any peer challenge suspicious work for a bounty paid from the bond of a guilty agent. An honest agent sails into the harbor once, posts its bond, and keeps working; a sybil farmer must fund a separate bond for every clone, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds. Like a nebula collapsing into stars, scattered claims condense into a few verifiable actors, while the quiet lagoon of low-stake spam dries up because each fake account now carries real, forfeitable cost.
